Class Dense

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.nn.Dense
public final class Dense extends Object
Fully connected layer. Weights are laid out [in][out] so both passes run as "y += w_row * x_i" over a contiguous row: that shape is what HotSpot auto-vectorises, and it lets zero inputs (ReLU outputs, empty mask cells) be skipped outright.
